units.source_text: 紫姬的庭院内正在栽种花木，

en.t: Flowers and trees were being planted in Lady Murasaki's garden,

units.source_text: 朔风来得如此猛烈，教这些“疏花小萩”难于禁受。

en.t: but the north wind blew so violently that these sparse-flowering little bush clovers could hardly endure it.

units.source_text: 花枝处处折断，

en.t: Flowering branches were broken everywhere,

units.source_text: 叶上的露水全都吹落了。

en.t: and all the dew on the leaves had been blown away.

units.source_text: 紫姬坐在窗内凝望。

en.t: Lady Murasaki sat inside by the window, gazing out intently.

units.source_text: 源氏正在西边小女公子房中。

en.t: Genji was in the room of the young princess on the west side.

units.source_text: 此时夕雾中将前来问候了。

en.t: Just then Lieutenant General Yugiri came to pay his respects.

units.source_text: 他无意中从东边渡廊的短屏上向开着的边门里一望，

en.t: By chance, from above the low screen along the eastern gallery, he glanced through an open side door,

units.source_text: 看见室内有许多侍女，便默不作声，在短屏旁边站定了。

en.t: and seeing many waiting women inside, he said nothing and stopped beside the low screen.

units.source_text: 为了朔风太大，室内的屏风都折叠起来，搁在一旁，

en.t: Because the north wind was so strong, all the screens in the room had been folded up and set aside,

units.source_text: 因此从外边可以望见厢房内部。

en.t: so it was possible to see into the side chamber from outside.

units.source_text: 但见有一个女子坐着，分明不是别人，正是紫姬本人。

en.t: There he saw a woman seated, and she was plainly none other than Lady Murasaki herself.

units.source_text: 气度高雅，容颜清丽，似有幽香逼人。

en.t: Her bearing was elegant, her face pure and beautiful, as though a faint fragrance were pressing toward him.

units.source_text: 教人看了，联想起春晨乱开在云霞之间的美丽的山樱。

en.t: To look at her called to mind beautiful mountain cherries blooming profusely among the clouds and mist of a spring morning.

units.source_text: 娇艳之色四散洋溢，仿佛流泛到正在放肆地偷看的夕雾脸上来。

en.t: Her radiant charm seemed to spread in every direction, as if it flowed onto the face of Yugiri as he boldly stole a look.

units.source_text: 真是个盖世无双的美人！

en.t: She was truly a peerless beauty beyond compare!

units.source_text: 一阵风来，把帘子吹起，众侍女连忙扯住，

en.t: A gust of wind came and blew up the blinds, and the waiting women hurried to hold them down,

units.source_text: 这么一来，引起紫姬嫣然一笑，那模样越发可爱了。

en.t: which made Lady Murasaki smile sweetly, and her appearance became all the more lovely.

units.source_text: 紫姬怜惜群花遭殃，舍不得离开它们回房中去。

en.t: Lady Murasaki pitied the flowers for their suffering and could not bear to leave them and return to her room.

units.source_text: 身边许多侍女，姿色也各尽其美，然而完全不在夕雾眼中。

en.t: Many waiting women were beside her, each lovely in her own way, but they did not enter Yugiri's eyes at all.

units.source_text: 他只是想道：“父亲严加防范，

en.t: He only thought, "My father keeps such strict watch

units.source_text: 不许我与这位继母接近，原来是她的相貌生得如此动人之故啊！

en.t: and forbids me to draw near this stepmother because her beauty is so deeply moving!

units.source_text: 他考虑得非常周到，深恐我见了她会起不良之心。”

en.t: He has considered everything so carefully, fearing that if I saw her I might be stirred to improper thoughts."

units.source_text: 想到这里，不禁害怕起来，立刻转身离去。

en.t: Thinking this, he could not help becoming afraid, and at once turned and went away.
